title: Guramba
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) ½ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: Peel raw mango and cut into slices or cubes & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Kary ko peel ker ka slices ya cubes mein cut ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In wok,add cooking oil,asafeotida,cumin seeds,fennel seeds,mustard seeds,nigella seeds and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein cooking oil,hing,zeera,saunf,raidana aur kalonji dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add raw mango and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Kary dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,red chili powder,red chili crushed and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,lal mirch powder aur lal mirch crushed dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and mix,cover and cook on low flame for 12-15 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal ker mix karein aur dhak ker halki ancch per 12-15 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add jaggery and mix well,cover and cook on low flame for 6-8 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Gur dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur halki ancch per 6-8 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Can be stored in an air tight container for up to 1 month.
steps.romanUrdu: Air tight container mein dal ker 1 month tak store ker saktay han.

ogDescription: Make the most of this mango season.Try this Guramba recipe and pack the goodness of raw mangoes in a bottle. #HappyCookingToYou
